verdict.rationale: SAM.gov is a federal entity-registration and procurement data portal with read-oriented search APIs. It does not host user-authored automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows SAM.gov shipping any automation-hosting capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
